newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline falls with futures as arb creaks shut.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline falls with futures as arb creaks shut.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices fell modestly on Friday after a sharp selloff in futures and as the arbitrage to the United States started to creak shut, traders said.
Eurograde barges ended down $2 at $194/$195 fob ARA but deals were heard late in the day at $192 and $192.50 as NYMEX unleaded futures lost more than two cents a gallon, or three percent.
No cargo deals were heard done but prices were notionally valued at $199/$201 cif for premium unleaded.
A noted buyer in the barge market in the last week, which had spawned talk of a squeeze, was not visibly supporting prices on Friday, traders said.
